name: Question 9
problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬(¬A⇔B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
worked_solution:
According to the definition of the biconditional, 

- $P⇔Q$ is true if $P⇒Q$ **and** $Q⇒P.$ Otherwise, it is false.

- In other words, $P⇔Q$ is true if $P$ and $Q$ have the same truth values. Otherwise, it is false.

First, we add a column for $¬A:$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |

Now, we add columns for $¬A⇔B$ and $¬(¬A⇔B).$

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,¬A\,$ | $\,¬A⇔B\,$ | $\,¬(¬A⇔B)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
